facts.label: Duas ações no passado
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para a ação longa e o passado simples para a curta: I was sleeping when the plane landed.

facts.label: Passado contínuo
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para ações em andamento: I was sleeping. It was raining. We were waiting. Com I, he, she e it use was. Com we, you e they use were.

facts.label: Passado simples
facts.sub: Use o passado simples para o que aconteceu de repente: the plane landed, we left, I got it. Verbos irregulares como got, left e put são muito comuns.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Was/were + -ing shows an action in progress.
We say “I was sleep when it landed”.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Was/were + -ing shows an action in progress. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “I was sleep when it landed”. → Falso (We say I was sleeping.)
Landed is past simple. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 2/2

answers: We use were with I. → Falso (We use was with I.)
When joins two past actions. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
